title: Gateway slot conflict resolution accepts replayed claims from other superframes
description: Security review P1. SlotClaim carries superframe_id, but resolve_conflict in rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs never compares the claims' superframe IDs or a current/freshness value. The trust helpers also verify only raw signatures and maintain no claim sequence/timestamp replay state. A captured lower-IID signed claim can be replayed in later superframes and still win/evict current slots, violating spec/08-gateway-coordination.md replay protection. Bind the signed transcript to operation/domain and superframe, require both claims match the current superframe/freshness window, persist per-gateway replay high-water, and add old/future/cross-superframe replay tests.
